title: How to Create a Mind | Ray Kurzweil | Talks at Google
summary: Ray Kurzweil presents his book How to Create a Mind at Google, on reverse engineering the brain and using that understanding to build intelligent machines. He shows his graphs of exponential technological progress.
why: Linked in threads about Kurzweil joining Google, mostly as a source for his exponential progress charts and his ambitions there.

quote.text: intro by Peter Norvig to a Google Talks event with Ray from a month ago
